nodes.summary: Let $\Lambda : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ be strictly increasing with $\Lambda(0) = 0$. The real linear span of the monomials $x \mapsto x^{\Lambda(n)}$, $n \in \mathbb{N}$, restricted to $[0, 1]$, is dense in $C([0, 1], \mathbb{R})$ with the uniform norm if and only if the series $\sum_{n \ge 0} 1/\Lambda(n+1)$ diverges, that is, the sequence $(1/\Lambda(n+1))_{n \in \mathbb{N}}$ is not summable.
nodes.title: Müntz–Szász theorem for integer exponents

nodes.summary: Let $K \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ be compact, let $U \subseteq \mathbb{C}$ be open with $K \subseteq U$, and let $f : \mathbb{C} \to \mathbb{C}$ be analytic at every point of $U$. Then for every real $\varepsilon > 0$ there are complex polynomials $p$ and $q$ such that $q(z) \ne 0$ for every $z \in K$ and $|f(z) - p(z)/q(z)| < \varepsilon$ for every $z \in K$.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.
